description: B attack-only distributed profile; explicit reassignment of existing namespace IPs

bridge.note: API binds 0.0.0.0 and is reached by clients at 10.20.0.1:8000. The mock LLM stays on loopback 127.0.0.1:8001.

management.note: Only these addresses may be used for /health, /_metrics/usage, /dashboard and scripts/reset_state. Never add a benign or attacker address.

benign_accounts.note: Reserved for the benign generator pool. user50 is NOT benign.

probe.note: Hook for decoy and connection-churn probes. Run one probe workload per run ID and reset state between them, because a C2 honeypot hit bans this address.
